Prefix the arbitrary-property class with a breakpoint variant:

```html
<div class="[--gutter-width:1rem] lg:[--gutter-width:2rem]">
```

Source: `src/docs/styling-with-utility-classes.mdx` (§"Using arbitrary values", ~line 431-439). Same doc notes you can also set CSS variables directly (e.g. `bg-[--brand-color]`); combine any responsive prefix (`sm:`, `md:`, etc.) the same way as with normal utilities per `src/docs/responsive-design.mdx`.
